name: Lightning Limbs
effect: Enter a high-speed spin lasting ten seconds. You stay on the spot, but attack unarmed at +2 DC and defend at +2 — though you can't "jump back" when dodging.
note: Acrobatics in the 2004 source; Acrobatics is folded into Athletics here.

name: Running Hands
effect: Cross up to 100 m in three seconds in a dazzling chain of cartwheels and mid-air somersaults. Anything aimed at you while you do takes −6.

name: Feather Feet
effect: Run up to 100 m in three seconds — up to 20 m of it along a vertical surface or across the surface of water — and be very hard (−6) to hit while doing it.

name: Sky Somersaults
effect: Perform a heroic leap, making one attack and one parry at +4 DC during it. Anything aimed at you mid-leap is at −6 — unless it comes from someone else doing the same thing.

name: Water Bug
effect: Stand, walk or run on water for ten seconds.

name: Heaven Leap
effect: Surface safely from as deep as 100 m, obstructions permitting.

name: Wall Walking
effect: Climb any surface — vertical or even upside down — for up to 50 m, taking anywhere from fifteen seconds to ten minutes. Long enough to stand on a ceiling for ten minutes.
note: Climbing in the source; Climbing is folded into Athletics here. Name supplied — the source lists this feat without one.

name: Twin Shots
effect: Once per combat round, take two fire actions as part of any other action, however complex, without the usual penalties for being unbalanced or moving.
note: "Any ranged combat skill" in the source. Name supplied.

name: Second Wind
effect: Shrug off exhaustion — recover a level of fatigue.
note: Hung on the Stamina skill in the source. Stamina is not a skill in this edition, so it's homed on EN; the original's reserve-stamina wording becomes an exhaustion level.

name: Iron Body
effect: Set the pain aside — recover one wound level.
note: Hung on the Pain Resistance skill in the source. Pain Resistance is not a skill in this edition, so it's homed on WP. Name supplied.

name: Distant Strike
effect: Strike someone up to Ch'i Score ÷ 2 metres away (further with extra effort) for normal damage. The blow counts as magical.
note: HTH Combat in the source; unarmed combat lives under Melee here.

name: Umbrella Parry
effect: Intercept a blow aimed at anyone else within Ch'i Score ÷ 2 metres — you parry for them from where you stand.

name: Heroic Blow
effect: Attack or parry at +2 DC, counting as magical. Such an attack breaks a non-magical weapon even when it's successfully parried.

name: Hundred Pace Throw
effect: Throw three times as far as normal at +4 DC. Almost anything reasonably hard and bigger than a pebble — a playing card will do — hits for at least your unarmed damage +4.
note: Throwing in the source, which has no direct modern equivalent — provisionally homed on Athletics (see REVIEW). Name supplied.

name: Shot Out of the Air
effect: Throw a weapon to intercept an incoming missile and knock it off its course.
note: Throwing in the source; provisional home (see REVIEW). Name supplied.
